en: A sepia-toned historic postcard view of a small European town with a riverside promenade. People walk along a curved path beside a narrow river or canal lined with a low railing. Traditional gabled houses and larger town buildings stand on both sides, with leafless trees in the foreground. In the background rise several towers and church spires dominating the skyline. Printed text in the upper left reads "Döbeln i. Sa. Am Salzgraben".
